acceptanceCriteria: Every code citation in docs/specs/local-completion-policy-v0.md is an identifier reference (or a pinned form the checker accepts), with no LCP-V0 requirement text changed.
make line-citations-check passes before and after a scratch one-line insertion at the top of each cited file.
body: Residual from V1-1350 (PR #913, branch claude/docs-batch-1357-1372-1350, head 8d1a40dd5). V1-1350 replaced the lifecycle.go/types.go line citations in docs/specs/local-completion-policy-v0.md with function references. The spec's other code citations (internal/localcompletion/storage.go, finish.go and cmd/corvint/*) are still path:line and verified against the working tree, so ordinary edits to those files fail line-citations-check. The lane also found that script/check-line-citations.sh admits no commit-pinned citation form. Expected: every code citation in the spec survives a one-line insertion in its target file.
title: local-completion-policy-v0: remaining line-based citations (storage.go, finish.go, cmd/corvint) still drift; line-citations-check has no commit-pin form
